Looking at this question about SNIPR001 phage therapy, I need to recall the details of the clinical evaluation of this phage cocktail developed by SRI International and The Biopharm.

SNIPR001 is a phage cocktail designed to treat multidrug-resistant (specifically fluoroquinone-resistant) E. coli infections. In the preclinical/clinical evaluation of this therapy, a panel of fluoroquinone-resistant clinical E. coli isolates was used to assess the phage's lytic capability.

The panel used to evaluate SNIPR001 consisted of 115 fluoroquinone-resistant clinical E. coli samples.

[ANSWER]A[/ANSWER]
